COMPANY OVERVIEW
KKR is a leading global investment firm that offers alternative asset management as well as capital markets and insurance solutions. KKR aims to generate attractive investment returns by following a patient and disciplined investment approach, employing world-class people, and supporting growth in its portfolio companies and communities. KKR’s insurance subsidiaries offer retirement, life and reinsurance products under the management of Global Atlantic Financial Group. References to KKR’s investments may include the activities of its sponsored funds and insurance subsidiaries.
Position Summary
Global Atlantic's Bermuda team is seeking a technically strong senior analyst to play a key role in the development and enhancement of our proprietary ALM projection platform used for Bermuda EBS valuation, BSCR capital calculation, and Embedded Value reporting. The platform is in active expansion from its core valuation engine into end-to-end regulatory reporting, financial forecasting, and a broader suite of actuarial and investment analytics, including predictive modeling and AI-enabled capabilities. This role combines quantitative and financial modeling with hands-on Python and SQL development and applied AI/ML development, working directly on production ALM projection systems that run across multiple insurance entities and economic scenarios. The successful candidate will apply numerical computing, forecasting, scenario analysis, financial modeling, and machine learning techniques to support the continued development of the platform. The position will partner closely with Investments, Risk, Corporate Actuarial, FP&A, and Technology teams to deliver high-quality projection capabilities, scalable analytical tools, strong governance, and meaningful analytical insights. This role will be based in our Hamilton, Bermuda office.
Key Responsibilities
Support code development, enhancement and deployment of the ALM projection model used for quarterly Bermuda Economic Balance Sheet (EBS) valuation, BSCR capital calculation, and Embedded Value reporting
Develop EBS forecasting capabilities to support FP&A, Deal Team, and new business modeling
Develop and enhance numerical modeling capabilities for asset-liability analysis, forecasting, scenario analysis, and portfolio optimization, including efficient implementation of large-scale calculations
Design and maintain automated unit tests and CI/CD pipelines to validate precision and reproducibility of financial, actuarial, and asset projection outputs across model releases
Collaborate with Actuarial, Investment and Risk teams to ensure asset assumptions, financial assumptions, and ALM strategies are appropriately reflected in projections
Perform review and challenge of model results to ensure accuracy, reasonableness, and regulatory compliance
Develop and integrate predictive modeling, machine learning, and AI capabilities to support forecasting, model acceleration, scenario analysis, and broader actuarial and investment analytics within the ALM platform
Qualifications
Bachelor's or master's degree in actuarial science, mathematics, statistics, mathematical finance, computer science, engineering, or another quantitative discipline
2-6 years of experience in quantitative modeling, financial modeling, actuarial modeling, data science, or related analytical/model development roles is preferred
Strong Python programming skills required; experience with SQL and/or other programming languages is preferred. Candidates must be comfortable developing reusable, production-oriented analytical or modeling code rather than only performing ad-hoc analysis
Experience with numerical computing libraries such as NumPy and SciPy and data manipulation frameworks such as Polars, Pandas, or similar
Experience developing forecasting, simulation, optimization, scenario-analysis, financial, or actuarial projection models
Experience developing reusable analytical/modeling code and automated data or modeling workflows
Experience with numerical optimization, large-scale computation, or performance optimization is preferred
Experience with machine learning, predictive modeling, or AI application development, including integrating models into production analytical workflows, is preferred
Experience with cloud-based model development or deployment and modern AI/ML frameworks is a plus
Experience with actuarial valuation/projection platforms such as MG-ALFA, Prophet, or Moody's AXIS is a plus
Familiarity with insurance, investments, asset-liability management, Bermuda EBS, Solvency II, or U.S. Statutory valuation frameworks is a plus
Demonstrated ability to solve complex quantitative problems, learn new financial or actuarial concepts, and dive into technical details
The successful candidate will be a motivated, results-oriented professional who thrives in a dynamic environment. We are seeking someone who:
Excels at collaboration and communication, building strong cross-functional relationships
Works well under pressure in a fast-paced environment
Is persistent when developing a solution to a problem

회사 소개
쿠팡은 고객 감동 실현을 위해 존재합니다. 고객들이 "쿠팡 없이 그동안 어떻게 살았을까?" 라고 말할 때, 비로소 우리의 미션을 실현하고 있음을 알 수 있습니다. 고객들의 쇼핑과 식사, 생활 전반을 편하게 만들겠다는 유일한 집념으로 쿠팡은 수억 달러 규모의 이커머스 산업 전반의 혁신을 이끌고 있습니다. 쿠팡은 가장 빠르게 성장하는 이커머스 기업 중 하나로, 국내 커머스 업계에서의 독보적인 입지와, 고객 신뢰를 구축했습니다.
쿠팡은 스타트업 문화를 기반으로 한 글로벌 대형 상장사라고 자부합니다. 이것이 창립 당시의 기민함을 유지하며, 신규 서비스를 끊임없이 출시하며 비즈니스를 확장해 나가는 우리의 성장 동력입니다. 쿠팡의 모든 임직원에게는 기업가 정신을 갖추고 새로운 혁신과 이니셔티브를 추진할 수 있는 기회가 주어집니다. 주저 없이 일에 뛰어들어 성과를 이루고자 하는 과감성이, 바로 쿠팡이 일하는 방식의 본질입니다. 쿠팡에서는 여러분 자신, 동료, 팀 그리고 회사 전체가 매일 성장하는 모습을 목격할 것입니다.
쿠팡의 모든 직원은 커머스의 미래를 만들겠다는 쿠팡의 미션에 진심입니다. 우리는 고객의 문제를 해결해 나가고, 전통적인 관념과 통념에 맞서며 실현 가능한 한계를 뛰어넘고 있습니다. 고가용성 (always-on) 과 최첨단의 앞선 기술 (high-tech), 초연결사회 (hyper-connected world) 에서의 놀라운 업무 경험을 원하신다면, 지금 바로 쿠팡에 합류하세요.
